subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The professor refused to comment on the __erroneous__ description of the historical events in the journal.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Inacurrate'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The underlined word is **Erroneous. **
 
• **Erroneous **means not correct; based on wrong information.(अशुद्घ; ग़लत सूचना पर आधारित)
 
 
• **Example:** They did nothing to dispel his erroneous belief about Indian Constitution.
 
 
 
• The marked option 'Inaccurate' means not correct or accurate; with mistakes.(जो सही या वास्‍तविक या यथार्थ न हो; त्रुटियुक्त)
 
• Therefore, from the **given meaning** and** example sentence**,** Inaccurate** and** Erroneous **are** synonyms.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Suitable-** right or appropriate for a particular person, purpose, or situation. (किसी विशेष व्यक्ति, उद्देश्य या स्थिति के लिए सही या उपयुक्त। )
 
• **Lucid-** expressed clearly; easy to understand. (स्पष्ट रूप से व्यक्त; समझने में आसान।)
 
• **Sensitive- **quick to detect or respond to slight changes, signals, or influences. (थोड़े से बदलाव, संकेतों या प्रभावों का पता लगाने या प्रतिक्रिया देने में तेज।)
